contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #346: Sharp singular-set bounds for stationary integral varifolds.

Audit AE lt:config and pk:reverse under the literal stationary-integral normal-cylinder hypotheses, including all exceptional projection fibers; no conclusion about either main regularity theorem follows from this bounded audit alone.

definitions.mu: weight of a stationary integral m-varifold in the interior normal cylinder
definitions.tau: abs(M)+D+Lambda; packing nu means tau, not pi_pushforward(mu)
definitions.regular: local varifold equality q|Sigma| with one smooth embedded minimal submanifold

A first-stopped-cube descent controls every support height and gives L^p bounds and quantitative small-set L^2 bounds from its scale-wise energy charges.

Upstream contact/envelope/barrier estimates and pk:witnesses supply witness tilt, transition control, polynomial dilation, and normal-flux lower bounds.
AE pk:packing and pk:contact-charge turn controlled-density witnesses into the signed-excess induction conclusion.
AE centering and inward-frequency arguments upgrade signed excess to neighborhood equality with one embedded minimal submanifold.
October Sections 04-07 establish prescribed-scale fitting, centered nonzero blowups, density-center retention, and dimension reduction; not certified in this bounded mission.

claims.natural_statement: For every finite index set, nonnegative real weights w, and real height and flux arrays v and q, (sum w*v*q)^4 <= (sum w*v^4)*(sum w*q^2)^2*(sum w). This is only the finite weighted Holder algebra used in pk:bad-flux, not the varifold concentration theorem.

Two L^2 moment bounds alone do not force a small-set flux gain: an atom of mass delta with v=q=1 has both squared norms delta and flux delta on a set of mass delta. This abstract nonstationary example is not a counterexample to AE.

For every finite index set, nonnegative real weights w, and real height and flux arrays v and q, (sum w*v*q)^4 <= (sum w*v^4)*(sum w*q^2)^2*(sum w). This is only the finite weighted Holder algebra used in pk:bad-flux, not the varifold concentration theorem.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

namespace SignedExcessAudit

theorem finite_weighted_flux_fourth
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w v q : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * v i * q i) ^ 4 ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, w i * v i ^ 4) *
        (∑ i ∈ s, w i * q i ^ 2) ^ 2 * (∑ i ∈ s, w i) := by
  have h₁ :
      (∑ i ∈ s, w i * v i * q i) ^ 2 ≤
        (∑ i ∈ s, w i * v i ^ 2) * (∑ i ∈ s, w i * q i ^ 2) := by
    apply Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul s
    · intro i hi
      exact mul_nonneg (hw i hi) (sq_nonneg (v i))
    · intro i hi
      exact mul_nonneg (hw i hi) (sq_nonneg (q i))
    · intro i hi
      exact le_of_eq (by ring)
  have h₂ :
      (∑ i ∈ s, w i * v i ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤
        (∑ i ∈ s, w i * v i ^ 4) * (∑ i ∈ s, w i) := by
    apply Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul s
    · intro i hi
      exact mul_nonneg (hw i hi) (by positivity)
    · exact hw
    · intro i hi
      exact le_of_eq (by ring)
  have hV : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, w i * v i ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i hi => mul_nonneg (hw i hi) (sq_nonneg (v i))
  have hE : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, w i * q i ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i hi => mul_nonneg (hw i hi) (sq_nonneg (q i))
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * v i * q i) ^ 4 =
        ((∑ i ∈ s, w i * v i * q i) ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ ((∑ i ∈ s, w i * v i ^ 2) *
        (∑ i ∈ s, w i * q i ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
      gcongr
    _ = (∑ i ∈ s, w i * v i ^ 2) ^ 2 *
        (∑ i ∈ s, w i * q i ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ ((∑ i ∈ s, w i * v i ^ 4) * (∑ i ∈ s, w i)) *
        (∑ i ∈ s, w i * q i ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h₂ (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = (∑ i ∈ s, w i * v i ^ 4) *
        (∑ i ∈ s, w i * q i ^ 2) ^ 2 * (∑ i ∈ s, w i) := by ring

theorem interpolation_exponent (m p : ℝ) :
    2 / p + (1 - 2 / p) * (1 - m / 2) =
      1 - m * (1 / 2 - 1 / p) := by ring

theorem uniform_concentration_exponent (m : ℕ) :
    (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1)) ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - (m : ℝ) / (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1)) := by
  constructor
  · positivity
  · have hm : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    have h : (m : ℝ) / (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hm).2
      nlinarith
    linarith

end SignedExcessAudit

claims.natural_statement: AE lt:potential: the full scalar gradient equation with finite measure data gives weak-L1 control of the absolutely continuous density modulo a constant and a finite-order distributional bound.
The normal projection Jacobian and the weighted rectifiable area formula give the integer counting measure and the full measure error <= C(D+Lambda), retaining deficient-rank projected mass.
Stationarity and integrality imply the ambient lower mass bound omega_m*r^m at every support point, also in the stationary extension across the artificial vertical boundary when separation holds.

For m>2, under the literal AE local cylinder and printed fixed-well witness inputs, every measurable E satisfies integral_E G_s |V_b(z)/s|^2 dmu <= C k^(-1) delta (integral_E G_s dmu)^(2/m), uniformly in scale, k, level, and E, including exceptional projection fibers. This yields weak critical exponent 2m/(m-2), not a strong endpoint moment.
The normal projection Jacobian and the weighted rectifiable area formula give the integer counting measure and the full measure error <= C(D+Lambda), retaining deficient-rank projected mass.

The target dimension here equals m, and h includes the positive integer multiplicity.
